units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 7. The information in paragraph 4 and withdrawal information in paragraph 6 of this Article shall be signed with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on behalf of the participant. The information shall be deemed sent, and the complaint withdrawn, when the corresponding information is posted under this Article in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 8. No later than two working days starting on the day after the paragraph 4 information is posted under paragraph 5 of this Article in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law, the procurement oversight body shall, except in the case specified in paragraph 6 of this Article, post in that register information:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) accepting the complaint for substantive consideration, stating the date, time and place and the possibility of using videoconferencing under Article 106(2) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) refusing acceptance for substantive consideration, with reasons, where:
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: а) the complaint was filed in breach of this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 8 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: б) a court or procurement oversight body has already decided a complaint against the same acts or omissions of the oversight subject or subjects.
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 8 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 9. No later than three hours after the information under paragraph 8 of this Article is posted in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law, the following shall be sent through the unified information system to the complaining participant and the oversight subject or subjects whose acts or omissions are challenged:
units.label: Part 9 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) notice that information accepting the complaint for substantive consideration has been posted, stating the date, time and place and the possibility of videoconferencing under Article 106(2) of this Federal Law, where information is posted under paragraph 8(1) of this Article. If the challenged acts or omissions are those of a contract service, contract manager, procurement commission or its members, the notice shall be sent to the contracting authority or the authorised body or institution vested with powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law. This notice constitutes proper notification to the complainant and the oversight subject or subjects of the date, time and place of substantive consideration;
units.label: Point 1 Part 9 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) notice refusing acceptance for substantive consideration, specifying the applicable case under paragraph 8(2) of this Article, where information is posted under paragraph 8(2) of this Article. If the challenged acts or omissions are those of a contract service, contract manager, procurement commission or its members, the notice shall be sent to the contracting authority or the authorised body or institution vested with powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 9 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 10. In a closed tender or closed auction, or procurement under Article 111 (where special arrangements under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 1) the complaint shall be filed in writing with the procurement oversight body without using the unified procurement information system. Fax and email filing are prohibited. In a closed tender or closed auction, the complaining participant need not be registered in the unified information system;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 2) the complaint shall contain the information in paragraph 4 of this Article, information on the complainant under Article 43(1)(1), subpoints г and е, of this Federal Law, and the postal address or addresses of the oversight subject or subjects challenged, and shall be signed by a person authorised to act for the participant. It shall include the invitation in a closed tender or closed auction and, if filed by a representative, a power of attorney or other document confirming authority to sign the complaint;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 3) no later than two working days starting on the day after receipt, the procurement oversight body shall send the complainant information accepting the complaint for substantive consideration, stating its date, time and place, or refusing acceptance in the cases under paragraph 5 and paragraph 8(2) of this Article. Information accepting the complaint, with the date, time and place and a copy of the complaint, shall also be sent within that period to the oversight subject or subjects challenged;
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 105. Procedure for filing a complaint against actions (omissions) of entities subject to control
units.text: 4) before the date of substantive consideration, the participant may withdraw its complaint by sending the procurement oversight body a written withdrawal request without using the unified information system. Fax and email withdrawal requests are prohibited. The request shall be signed by a person authorised to act for the participant and, if filed by a representative, accompanied by a power of attorney or other document confirming authority to sign it. If the oversight body receives the withdrawal request before considering the merits, it shall not consider the complaint on the merits. The participant may not file another complaint against the same acts or omissions in the procurement concerned.
units.label: Point 4 Part 10 Art. 105

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.label: Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 1. Persons whose rights and lawful interests are directly affected by consideration of a complaint may submit objections to the procurement oversight body and participate personally or through representatives. Objections shall be submitted no later than the working day preceding substantive consideration.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 2. Persons authorised to act for the complaining participant or for the oversight subject or subjects challenged may participate in substantive consideration, including by videoconferencing if the procurement oversight body has the technical capability.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 3. The procurement oversight body shall consider the complaint and objections on the merits within five working days of receipt of the complaint and notify the complainant and objectors of the results. It may request information and documents needed for consideration, including from oversight subjects.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 4. The complainant may not be required to provide information or documents held by State bodies, including State authorities, local self-government bodies or bodies subordinate to them. The procurement oversight body shall obtain these itself. Substantive consideration shall be collegial. The complainant may submit information and documents supporting its arguments. On the day of substantive consideration, the complaining participant may withdraw its complaint directly during the hearing.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 5. Oversight subjects challenged shall submit for substantive consideration the procurement documentation where required by this Federal Law, applications for supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, records required by this Federal Law, audio and video recordings, and other information and documents prepared during selection or accreditation on an electronic or specialised electronic platform.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 5.1. Information and documents in paragraph 5 of this Article need not be supplied if posted on the official website under this Federal Law. If the paragraph 5 information and documents on that website differ from those prepared during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection or accreditation on an electronic or specialised electronic platform, those posted on the official website shall prevail.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 6. Complaints shall not be considered concerning the results of evaluation of tender applications and final offers under the evaluation criteria in Article 32(1), points 3 and 4, of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 7. The procurement oversight body may suspend supplier (contractor, service provider) selection as regards conclusion of the contract until substantive consideration of the complaint, by sending a binding suspension requirement to the contracting authority, specialised electronic platform operator in cases set by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 24(13)(3) of this Federal Law, authorised body or institution, and specialised organisation. In electronic and closed electronic procedures, other than cases set by the Government under Article 24(13)(3) of this Federal Law, if suspension is decided, the oversight body shall implement it through the unified procurement information system when posting information under Article 105(8)(1) of this Federal Law. If suspension is decided, the contract may not be concluded until the merits are considered. The conclusion period shall be extended by the period of substantive consideration.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 8. Following substantive consideration, the procurement oversight body shall decide whether the complaint is justified or unjustified, decide where necessary to take action under Article 99(22), points 1 and 3, of this Federal Law, and where necessary issue a mandatory remedial order under Article 99(22)(2) of this Federal Law. No later than three working days after the decision or order, it shall:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 1) except for closed competitive methods and procurement under Article 111 (where arrangements under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law, post the substantive decision and any remedial order in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law and send copies to persons who submitted objections under this Article;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 2) for closed competitive methods and procurement under Article 111 (where arrangements under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law, send copies of the substantive decision and any remedial order to the complainant, oversight subject or subjects challenged, and persons who submitted objections under this Article.
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 8.1. No later than three hours after information under paragraph 8(1) of this Article is posted in the register under Article 99(21) of this Federal Law, the unified information system shall send notice that the substantive decision and any remedial order have been posted to the complainant, oversight subject or subjects challenged, the electronic platform operator for an electronic procedure if it is not itself challenged, and the specialised electronic platform operator for a closed electronic procedure if it is not itself challenged. If the challenged acts or omissions are those of a contract service, contract manager, procurement commission or its members, the notice shall be sent to the contracting authority or authorised body or institution vested with powers under Article 26 of this Federal Law. This notice constitutes proper notification to the complainant and the oversight subject or subjects of the results of substantive consideration.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 9. The substantive decision may be challenged in court within three months after its adoption.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 106. Examination of a complaint on its merits
units.text: 10. If the authorised federal executive authority, constituent-entity executive authority and local self-government bodies of municipal districts, municipal okrugs or urban okrugs have considered complaints against the same acts or omissions of oversight subjects, the authorised federal authority's decision shall be implemented. If the authorised constituent-entity executive authority and those local self-government bodies have considered complaints against the same acts or omissions, the authorised constituent-entity authority's decision shall be implemented.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 106

units.locator: Article 107. Liability for violations of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: Article 107. Liability for violations of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.label: Art. 107

units.locator: Article 107. Liability for violations of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 1. Persons responsible for violating Russian Federation legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system shall bear disciplinary, civil, administrative or criminal liability under Russian Federation legislation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 107

units.locator: Article 107. Liability for violations of legislation of the Russian Federation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system
units.text: 2. Operators of electronic platforms and specialised electronic platforms and their officials shall bear disciplinary, civil, administrative or criminal liability under Russian Federation legislation for violations of legislation or other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system, and shall compensate persons for losses caused by unlawful acts or omissions, including disclosure of information obtained during electronic procedures.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 107

units.locator: Chapter 7. SPECIAL RULES FOR CERTAIN TYPES OF PROCUREMENT
units.text: Chapter 7. SPECIAL RULES FOR CERTAIN TYPES OF PROCUREMENT
units.label: Chapter 7. SPECIAL RULES FOR CERTAIN TYPES OF PROCUREMENT

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.label: Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 1. To ensure energy efficiency when procuring goods, work or services in natural monopoly sectors; water supply, wastewater disposal, heat supply or gas supply services, other than sale of liquefied gas not used as motor fuel; connection to engineering infrastructure networks at prices or tariffs regulated under Russian Federation legislation; and supplies of electricity, fuel oil, coal or fuel used to generate energy, contracting authorities may conclude energy service contracts for the service provider to take measures aimed at energy saving and increasing the efficiency of use of those energy resources, hereinafter energy service contracts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 2. An energy service contract shall be concluded separately from contracts for goods, work or services in natural monopoly sectors; water supply, wastewater disposal, heat supply, gas supply or connection to engineering infrastructure networks at prices or tariffs regulated under Russian Federation legislation; and supplies of electricity, fuel oil, coal or fuel used to generate energy, hereinafter for this Article supplies of energy resources. It shall be concluded in the procedure established by this Federal Law, taking account of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 3. The initial (maximum) price of an energy service contract or lot shall be determined with reference to the contracting authority's actual energy resource supply expenditure in the previous year and may not exceed it, subject to special rules established by the Government of the Russian Federation under paragraph 19 of this Article. The procurement notice and documentation, where required by this Federal Law, shall specify that initial (maximum) price, including energy resource supply expenditure for each type of goods, work or services, quantities and unit costs, and one of the following conditions:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 1) a fixed monetary amount of savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure and the maximum percentage of those savings payable to the service provider under the energy service contract;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 2) a fixed percentage of monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure payable to the service provider under the contract, and the minimum monetary amount of those savings;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 3) a minimum monetary amount of savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure and the maximum percentage of those savings payable to the service provider under the contract.
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 4. The draft energy service contract sent by the contracting authority to the supplier shall be based on energy resource consumption volumes agreed in the procedure established by Russian Federation legislation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 5. The contracting authority or authorised body or institution may specify in the procurement notice and documentation, where required by this Federal Law, the maximum possible expenditure of the contracting authority associated with performance of the energy service contract.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 6. When an energy service contract is concluded through a tender or request for quotations, the contracting authority or authorised body or institution shall also state in the procurement notice and documentation, where required by this Federal Law, that the application must include one of the following offers:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 1) the contract price or, in the case specified in paragraph 3(1) of this Article, the percentage of savings;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 2) in the case specified in paragraph 3(2) of this Article, an amount equal to the difference between the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure, that is, the initial (maximum) contract price, and the participant's proposed monetary savings in that expenditure;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 3) in the case specified in paragraph 3(3) of this Article, an amount equal to the difference between the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure, that is, the initial (maximum) contract price, and the participant's proposed monetary savings, after reducing those savings by the monetary value corresponding to the percentage of savings proposed by the participant.
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 7. When an energy service contract is concluded through a tender or request for quotations, the application shall contain the offers under paragraph 6, points 1–3, of this Article, depending on the conditions in the procurement notice and documentation, where documentation is required by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 8. In the cases specified in paragraph 6, points 2 and 3, of this Article, the person offering the lowest amount shall win the request for quotations.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 9. In the cases specified in paragraph 6, points 2 and 3, of this Article, to determine the best performance terms offered in tender applications, the procurement commission shall evaluate and compare the proposed amount instead of the contract-price criterion, to identify the best terms, the relevant energy resource supply expenditure the contracting authority will incur from concluding and performing the energy service contract, and its expenditure under that contract. Applications shall be examined and evaluated under the proposed-amount criterion using the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 32(8) of this Federal Law for the contract-price criterion, subject to this Article.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 10. An auction for an energy service contract shall proceed by reducing one of the following indicators:
units.label: Part 10 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 1) the energy service contract price or, in the case specified in paragraph 3(1) of this Article, the percentage of savings;
units.label: Point 1 Part 10 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 2) in the case specified in paragraph 3(2) of this Article, an amount equal to the difference between the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure, that is, the initial (maximum) contract price, and the auction participant's proposed monetary savings in that expenditure;
units.label: Point 2 Part 10 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 3) in the case specified in paragraph 3(3) of this Article, an amount equal to the difference between the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure, that is, the initial (maximum) contract price, and the auction participant's proposed monetary savings, after reducing those savings by the monetary value corresponding to the percentage of savings proposed by that participant.
units.label: Point 3 Part 10 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 11. In the cases specified in paragraph 10, points 2 and 3, of this Article, the person offering the lowest amount shall win the auction.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 12. In the case specified in paragraph 10(3) of this Article, when the energy service contract is concluded, the auction winner, or the participant with whom it is concluded if the winner evades conclusion, shall determine the monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure and the percentage of those savings, taking account of the minimum and maximum percentages specified in the procurement documentation, where required by this Federal Law, and that winner's or participant's proposed amount.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 13. The energy service contract price shall take the form of:
units.label: Part 13 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 1) in the case specified in paragraph 3(1) of this Article, the fixed percentage of monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure proposed by the participant with whom the contract is concluded;
units.label: Point 1 Part 13 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 2) in the case specified in paragraph 3(2) of this Article, the fixed percentage of monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure proposed by the participant with whom the contract is concluded;
units.label: Point 2 Part 13 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 3) in the case specified in paragraph 3(3) of this Article, the percentage of monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy resource supply expenditure proposed by the participant with whom the contract is concluded.
units.label: Point 3 Part 13 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 14. The energy service contract shall specify savings in physical units for each type of energy resource supplied to the contracting authority, calculated from the fixed monetary savings in the case under paragraph 3(1) of this Article, or the participant's proposed monetary savings in the cases under paragraph 3, points 2 and 3, of this Article, and the unit cost of each good, work or service stated in the procurement notice and documentation, where required by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 15. The contract shall also specify the participant's proposed percentage of savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure in the cases under paragraph 3, points 1 and 3, of this Article, or the fixed percentage in the case under paragraph 3(2) of this Article. That percentage may not be changed during performance.
units.label: Part 15 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 16. The contracting authority shall set energy service contract performance security at between one half percent and thirty percent of one of the following amounts:
units.label: Part 16 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 1) in the case specified in paragraph 3(1) of this Article, the maximum percentage of the fixed monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure payable to the service provider under the contract;
units.label: Point 1 Part 16 Art. 108

units.locator: Article 108. Special rules for concluding energy service contracts
units.text: 2) in the case specified in paragraph 3(2) of this Article, the fixed percentage of the minimum monetary savings in the contracting authority's relevant energy supply expenditure payable to the service provider under the contract;
units.label: Point 2 Part 16 Art. 108
